name: Resonance Core Chamber
description: The Resonance Core Chamber is the heart of the Basilica of Adumbration. A massive void‑arcane engine pulses at its center, stabilizing and destabilizing the megastructure in unpredictable cycles. Custodian constructs guard the chamber, echo entities manifest from resonance distortions, and Akhevan ritualists attempt to seize control of the core.
